sections.content: Welcome to QuantMesh Market Maker ("the System"). The System is provided solely for quantitative trading research, backtesting, and educational purposes and does not constitute investment advice or financial services of any kind.

sections.title: 2. Definitions
sections.content: "The System" means the QuantMesh Market Maker software and all its components (including but not limited to backend services, web interface, strategy engine, and API integrations). "User" or "You" means any natural person, legal entity, or unincorporated organization that accesses or uses the System. "Exchange" means any third-party cryptocurrency trading platform that you connect to via the System. "Trading" means any order placement, closing of positions, leverage adjustment, or other digital-asset-related operations you conduct through the System or an exchange.

sections.title: 3. Description and Nature of Service
sections.content: QuantMesh is a quantitative trading system that supports grid trading, dollar-cost averaging (DCA), martingale, and combined strategies, among others. The System communicates with exchanges via API keys that you configure and executes strategies and risk controls that you define. The System may be deployed and run on your local machine or your own infrastructure. We provide software tools only; we do not custody user funds, execute trading decisions on your behalf, or guarantee the availability, compliance, or stability of any exchange. You are solely responsible for strategy configuration, parameter tuning, monitoring of positions and system status, and day-to-day operations.

sections.content: You represent and warrant that: (a) you have reached the age of majority and have full legal capacity in your jurisdiction; (b) your use of the System and any related trading activity complies with the laws, regulations, and supervisory requirements of your country or region, including but not limited to securities, derivatives, anti-money laundering, and foreign exchange controls; (c) you are not a sanctioned party or otherwise prohibited from engaging in financial activities. If the System is prohibited or restricted in your jurisdiction, you must not use it. You are solely responsible for any liability or consequences arising from a breach of the foregoing.

sections.title: 5. Risk Disclosure and Financial Disclaimer
sections.content: Cryptocurrency and derivative trading involves significant risk and may result in partial or total loss of principal, including in excess of initial margin. Price volatility, illiquidity, exchange failures, leverage effects, and liquidation mechanisms may all lead to substantial losses. Past backtest or live performance does not guarantee future results; historical data and simulation results are for reference only. The System is provided "as is" and "as available" without any express or implied warranties (including but not limited to merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or non-infringement). Any live or simulated trading you conduct using the System is your own decision; you should fully understand the relevant risks and ensure you have the corresponding risk tolerance. Investment involves risk; trade with caution.

sections.title: 6. No Investment Advice
sections.content: The System, its documentation, interfaces, example strategies, and backtest results do not constitute investment advice, financial advice, an offer, or a solicitation of any kind. We do not endorse or evaluate the suitability, profitability, or legality of any asset, exchange, or strategy. All trading decisions are made by you independently; you may seek independent advice from licensed financial institutions or professionals at your discretion.

sections.title: 7. User Responsibilities
sections.content: You agree to: (a) keep your login credentials, API keys, and any account-related information confidential and not disclose them to others; (b) grant the System only the minimum API permissions necessary to execute your strategies and to review and rotate keys periodically; (c) understand the risk characteristics of cryptocurrencies, leverage, derivatives, and the strategies involved; (d) continuously monitor positions, margin, liquidation levels, and system operation; (e) bear full responsibility for any losses arising from misuse, configuration errors, network outages, exchange rule changes, or market anomalies by you or those you authorize. The System and QuantMesh-related parties assume no liability for the foregoing.

sections.title: 1. Introduction and Scope
sections.content: QuantMesh Market Maker ("the System") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we treat information related to your use of the System. The System is designed to run on your local machine or your own infrastructure; therefore, most data remains under your control and is stored in environments you control. We will not use your personal or trading data for purposes other than those described in this policy without your consent or where required by law. Please read this policy carefully before using the System; if you do not agree, do not use the System.

sections.title: 2. Information We May Process
sections.content: When you use the System, it may process the following types of data on the machine where you deploy it: configuration data (e.g., exchange selection, strategy parameters, risk limits; API keys and credentials are stored only in your local configuration); operational and trading data (e.g., order records, positions, fills, funding rates, system and audit logs); usage and performance data (e.g., interface access, error logs, performance metrics). By default, such data is stored in the environment where you run the System; we do not actively collect or upload it to servers we control unless you explicitly configure integrations such as cloud backup or remote monitoring. If you contact us via our website, email, or support channels, we may process the contact details and content you provide.

sections.title: 3. Purposes of Use
sections.content: We use relevant information only for: providing, maintaining, and improving the System's functionality; executing your configured strategies and communicating with exchanges in your local environment; troubleshooting, security auditing, and compliance needs; disclosure where required by law or with your consent. We do not use your personal or trading data for marketing, resale, or sharing with unrelated third parties.

sections.title: 4. Data Storage and Security
sections.content: Data is primarily stored on the machine where you deploy QuantMesh (including strategy configurations, positions, order history, system metrics, and logs). You are responsible for implementing appropriate security measures for that environment (e.g., access control, encryption, firewalls). We recommend: granting the System only the minimum API permissions necessary to execute your strategies; rotating API keys periodically; not exposing the management interface on untrusted networks. If you enable cloud backup or external monitoring, data will be processed according to the policies of the third-party services you choose; please review their privacy and security terms separately.

sections.title: 5. Third Parties and Exchange APIs
sections.content: When you connect to cryptocurrency exchanges through the System, the System sends requests on your behalf (e.g., placing orders, querying positions and market data). Exchanges process your API keys, IP address, and trading activity according to their own privacy policies and terms. We do not control how exchanges handle data. We strongly recommend using API keys with minimal permissions and connecting only to exchanges you trust. If you use other third-party services integrated with the System (e.g., notifications, data feeds), their data practices are governed by those third parties' policies.

sections.title: 6. Cookies and Sessions
sections.content: The System's web interface uses session cookies and similar technologies to maintain login state and security verification. These are typically stored in your browser or local environment and are not used for cross-site tracking or sharing with advertisers. You may manage or disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect login or some functionality.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
sections.content: Retention of data generated by the System on your local machine is under your control (including backup and deletion policies). We do not retain your personal or trading data on our own servers for extended periods unless required by law or necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy. When you uninstall or stop using the System, please delete local data or handle it according to your data policies.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights
sections.content: To the extent permitted by applicable law, you may have rights to access, rectify, delete, or restrict processing of your personal data, as well as to object to processing and data portability. Because data is primarily stored locally, you may access, modify, or delete it directly. If you believe we process your personal data and wish to exercise your rights, please contact us using the details in this policy; we will respond within the timeframes required by law. You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in your region.

sections.title: 9. International and Local Deployment
sections.content: The System may be deployed in different regions worldwide. If you use it in the EU, UK, or other regions with specific requirements for cross-border data transfers, please note: when data is kept only on your local machine, cross-border transfer is largely determined by you and any cloud or third-party services you choose. We do not actively transfer your data to servers we control outside your region unless required to comply with legal obligations or with your consent.

sections.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may revise this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect product changes, legal requirements, or best practices. The revised policy will be marked with an updated "Last updated" date and will be available in the System or through channels we provide. For material changes, we may notify you via in-app notice, email, or announcement. Continued use of the System after changes take effect constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy; if you do not agree, please stop using the System and delete local data.

sections.title: 11. Contact Us
sections.content: For any questions, requests, or complaints regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: contact@quantmesh.io. We will endeavor to respond within a reasonable time. If your jurisdiction requires a designated data protection officer or representative, please indicate this in your message so we may comply with local requirements.
